The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

value.summary: Conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, develop an RFP scope of work document for open market bidding, and serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.
key_deliverables: Phase 1: ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review (by Dec 31, 2025)
Organizational readiness, technological capabilities, and data management review
Cloud readiness assessment, data residency analysis, and SWOC analysis
Market Intelligence Report detailing ERP solutions, modules, and price points
Phase 2: Development of Request for Proposal (RFP) for ERP Solution (by Feb 02, 2026)
Detailed scope of work, functional/technical specifications, and pricing matrix
Phase 3: ERP Vendor Evaluation and Selection Process (by May 29, 2026)
Proposal review, compatibility assessment, reference checks, and demo facilitation
Attendance at minimum six (6) in-person project meetings

evidence.quote: To pursue this goal, the County is seeking proposals from experienced and qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, followed by the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County’s appointed project team members, and to serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.

value.detail: Minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) years; PMP/PMI certification preferred
Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) years
Qualifications relative to providing ERP consulting services within a municipal environment for commercial ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.

evidence.quote: The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.

Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.
Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

value.detail: Execution of mandatory County Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA #1.pdf)
Assess data management practices, data governance, quality, and security protocols
Evaluate security measures and compliance requirements for cloud data storage and transmission
Quality assurance (QA) processes with third-party certification (ISO 9001, ISO 14001)

evidence.quote: the selected proponent shall complete and sign the Independent Contractor Agreement... and a Non-Disclosure Agreement Separately Uploaded in the APC

Security Protocols: Define the security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system. This encompasses role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations.
